|lore=Jabba makes offers one cannot refuse. Smugglers, thieves and competitors who do not acquiesce have been rumored to wake up with a bantha’s head in their bed.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your bounty hunters (except Boba Fett) are power +1. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor. Once per game, if Jabba at Audience Chamber, may ▼ a non-bounty hunter alien. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The immediately effective 2005 replacement removes creature-attack protection for aliens at Jabba’s Palace sites, changes the bounty hunter bonus from +2 to +1, spells out Boba Fett and uses Emperor as printed. It makes the Jabba deployment once per game. The full card and slip attest the later remastered publication of those same clauses. [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438#106978 9 November 2005 official full replacement].
